Hannah: tiny life update  quietly had a micro backyard ceremony with Sam on Saturday and we also finished the housewarming (plants survived!). happy to host a tiny open-house + succulents swap next Thu 6pm if anyone wants to stop by. no gifts please, just snacks. :seedling::house_with_garden:
Diego: HANNAAH!!! congrats!!! :tada: would love to come by and also bring my famous empanadas. succulents swap sounds very 2026 :grin:
Mira: omg congrats hannah!! i'll come by and bring sparkling water + tiny plant pots. what should I bring for the swap? seeds or tiny pots?
Hannah: thanks!! tiny pots are great. if you have cuttings even better. thinking casual, bring a snack if you want but totally optional. parking is a bit tight so maybe carpool?
Kai: congrats hannah!! i can bike over and bring napkins. also bringing one very cheerful pothos.
Olive: congrats!!! i'll bring a little playlist and some fairy lights. would love to meet sam. :sparkles:
People Ops Bot: Congrats @Hannah  I've added "Hannah: Micro Ceremony + Housewarming" to the Celebrations calendar for 2026-06-18 18:00-19:00 PT. RSVP: https://calendar.example/celebrate-1911112233
Diego: RSVP'd. also if anyone wants to swap plant ID tips i'll bring little handwritten tags.
Mira: RSVP'd. also can we have a tiny sign: "Free Succulent Advice" :joy:
Hannah: love it. thanks everyone  see you next Thu, snacks and plants and very small ceremony stories :)
